subject: statistics on Nei's gene diversity for haploid organism

messages.author: 8ce694d5545e48a5
messages.subject: statistics on Nei's gene diversity for haploid organism
parts:
Hello,
this may be a silly question to ask, but I have been struggling to find a way how to statistically compare values of Nei's unbiased gene diversity between two populations. I have performed bootstrapping and confidence intervals for genotypic diversity measures (like evenness, Simpson index etc.) but can't find a way how to do it for genic diversity. Basically, I have two populations with Hexp 0.63 vs Hexp 0.76 and I have to find out whether they are statistically different. Will be grateful for suggestions.

Thanks!
Olga
